geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the dominant mass from a simple cantilever into a split-wing/courtyard-bearing volume so the street edge can open and hierarchy becomes legible.
Use the long-axis split to create a clearer public threshold and more coherent sectional reading.
Introduce a meaningful inter-wing gap that can function as a public void rather than a shallow clip.
Add a courtyard macro in the ancestry of the dominant mass to produce an actual open-space figure tied to the existing program seed.
Promote the new court-bearing structure to root so the public void is structurally central rather than incidental.
Align the court opening with the program-access side to repair the ground threshold response.
Increase void depth enough for the court to register as usable public space.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the single cantilever gesture with a split-wing / court-bearing massing rule so the ground edge can become a true public threshold.
Bias the dominant mass to open laterally toward the access edge rather than remain a compact sealed block.
Add a new void-supporting macro to create a legible public court at the ground plane while keeping the dominant mass in ancestry.
Align the courtyard opening to the verified program-side access orientation so the street edge reads as active and public.
Keep the void substantial enough to register as occupied public space rather than a decorative notch.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass in all views, so gesture clarity and repair integrity are acceptable. However, the dominant form is still a mostly sealed stepped block with a weak, shallow void strategy and no convincing active ground threshold toward the verified access edge. The section is generic and the stepped/canted silhouette does not clearly express a capacity-bearing terrace or a meaningful public court; instead it feels like an arbitrary mass clip. For neighborhood living, that makes the program support only partial: there is a plausible compact upper mass, but the required public threshold and usable void logic are underdeveloped. The form also does not strongly resonate with the more open, court-framed commercial precedents supplied. Because the access edge is not robustly answered, and the mass is too box-like with weak void publicness, it fails hard program fit.
